title: Build per-model quantization calibration matrix and cross-dataset reranker validation (FP8/INT8)
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: produce a reproducible per-model calibration matrix (FP8/INT8) paired with a cross-dataset reranker evaluation harness that reports NDCG@K and MRR regressions and produces pass/fail gates for rollout. This ticket coordinates the calibration sweeps, stores canonical calibration artifacts, defines dataset folds, and implements automated comparison dashboards. Outcomes: (1) calibrated quant profiles for selected reranker checkpoints, (2) an evaluation pipeline that runs on staging and reports per-query and aggregate NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR deltas versus float32 baseline, and (3) a gating policy for deployment to Dedicated/Private that ties to quality thresholds and rollback rules.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration matrix produced for 4 target reranker models (dense-bert-small-v3, dense-bert-base-v7, dense-bert-medium-v5, distil-rank-v2) with per-layer scaling parameters for FP8 and INT8
Calibration artifacts (quant params + histograms) are stored in S3 at s3://redwood-quant/calib-matrices/ENG-33821/ and versioned with model checksum
Evaluation harness runs nightly on the CrossRank test set and two external datasets (MS MARCO dev, InternalSearch-2025) and outputs NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR with 95% bootstrap CI
Automated gating: no more than 1.5% relative drop in NDCG@3 and 2.0% in MRR compared to float32; failures create a rollback PR and notify #rerank-quant Slack channel
Documentation: runbook describing calibration commands, how to reproduce a failed sweep, and how to add a new model to the matrix present in Confluence at /confluence/display/INF/ENG-33821
test_plan: Create baseline float32 run using canonical eval pipeline (docker image: redwood/eval:2026-02-1)
Run calibration sweeps for FP8 and INT8 using calib-runner script with 3 random seeds and collect per-layer activation histograms
Generate quantized model artifacts (int8, fp8-E4M3 and fp8-E5M2 flavors) and run reranker eval on three datasets using same prompts/queries
Compute NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR; run paired bootstrap test to compute p-values and 95% CI; surface both relative and absolute deltas
Run ablation: disable KV cache and re-evaluate to detect sensitivity to sequence-length distribution
Run latency and memory perf smoke tests on a dedicated t4g-small staging instance to detect regressions beyond the quality metrics
notes: Initial trade-off decision: prefer per-layer min-max+KL histogram calibration for INT8 and dynamic range + per-tensor scale for FP8 to reduce calibration footprint; design team reviewed and signaled OK
We will prioritize models where production traffic is >100 qps to get highest ROI on quant efforts
For INT8 we will include a fallback to symmetric-per-channel scales if asymmetric calibration shows instability on internal datasets
Edge case: some models show non-deterministic ranking differences due to tokenizer updates; ensure eval uses pinned tokenizer commit
Plan to handshake with Platform (ENG-32110) for S3 lifecycle and with Observability (ENG-33200) for dashboard hooks
